ĐỖ QUỲNH MAI

Warehouse Accountant

Warehouse accountant with over 7 years of experience working for both domestic and international companies. With proven expertise in accurate inventory control and proficiency in popular accounting software such as MISA, Fast, and Bravo, I have contributed to reducing product loss rates to below 1.2%, earning the recognition of Top 10 Employers of the Year. I aim to continue advancing my specialization in inventory control and warehouse accounting, especially in applying ERP software to optimize workflows, minimize shrinkage, and improve operational efficiency in manufacturing and trading enterprises.
